title: WishlistItem - Data API
description: Represents an item on a Wishlist in a store built with B2B Commerce for Lightning. Available in API version 49.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code for the currency that’s specified on the buyer’s account. Default value is USD.Possible values are: USD—U.S. Dollar

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of this WishlistItem record. Name can be up to 255 characters.

Product2Id.description: The ID of the product that is represented by the WishlistItem.

WishlistId.description: The ID of the parent Wishlist of this WishlistItem.

special_access_rules: The WishListItem object is available only if the B2B Commerce for Lightning license is enabled.
